settings.question: Do you ship internationally?
settings.answer: Yes! We offer worldwide shipping. Delivery times typically range from 7–15 business days, depending on your location.

settings.question: How can I track my order?
settings.answer: Once your order ships, you'll receive an email with a tracking link so you can follow it every step of the way.

settings.question: Are there customs fees?
settings.answer: For international orders, customers are responsible for any local customs duties or taxes incurred.

settings.question: What is your return policy?
settings.answer: We accept returns on most items within 14 days of delivery. Items must be in their original packaging and unworn.

settings.question: Are earrings returnable?
settings.answer: Due to hygiene reasons, earrings (including our crystal butterfly collection) are final sale unless they arrive damaged.

settings.question: How do I care for my Herprint jewelry?
settings.answer: To maintain the high brilliance of your 14k gold plating and natural zircon, avoid contact with water, perfumes, and lotions.

settings.question: How should I store my jewelry?
settings.answer: To prevent tarnishing, we include a reusable anti-oxidation bag with every order. When you're not wearing your jewelry, keep it sealed in the bag to protect it from moisture and air.

settings.question: How do I find my size?
settings.answer: Our Size Guide has full ring, necklace, and bracelet measurements, plus simple tips for measuring at home. Still unsure? Email hello@herprint.co and we'll help.

settings.title: Frequently Asked Questions
settings.intro: Everything you need to know about your order, returns, and caring for your Herprint pieces. Can't find your answer? We're always an email away.
